summary: Canonicalize the SQLite source-site inventory by stable site ID to reduce parallel-addition conflicts

replay.detail: Development inventory tooling only; replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: The inventory remains the same JSON schema and version; no database changes.

rules.detail: Source exception acceptance and runtime rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: All inventory consumers continue reading JSON with the same fields.

manual.detail: After reviewing inventory edits, run python3 scripts/check-sqlite-large-values --format to sort existing sites by ID and format one record per line. The guard rejects non-canonical formatting; formatting does not accept exceptions, refresh source metadata or change reviewed_base.

recovery.detail: No persistent runtime state changes; no recovery action required.
